Messages.Author: robyn tatu
Messages.Body:
Came up in our tournament this weekend:

Meth A plays Charming Lobby+Vote and calls no other vote that turn.
Meth B plays KRC that is not blocked.
Meth A plays Delaying tactics, cancelling the vote.

Is the Delaying Tactics legal here?

Does the Charming Lobby burn since the vote/action was a success?

Robyn Tatu

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
robyn tatu wrote:
> Came up in our tournament this weekend:
>
> Meth A plays Charming Lobby+Vote and calls no other vote that turn.
> Meth B plays KRC that is not blocked.
> Meth A plays Delaying tactics, cancelling the vote.
>
> Is the Delaying Tactics legal here?

No.
DT cannot be played on an auto-passing referendum.
See response to Atomweaver earlier this morning.

> Does the Charming Lobby burn since the vote/action was a success?

The CL auto-pass is used up on the referendum, which passes
automatically, yes.
